channel.title: CTV News – Toronto City Hall
channel.description: Toronto City Hall coverage from CTV News Toronto.

item.title: After election victory, Chow to face budget pressure and new deal with Ontario
Olivia Chow answered questions day after earning second term. Here’s everything she said
item.description: Olivia Chow spoke with reporters on Tuesday afternoon following a decisive win against Brad Bradford in the Toronto mayoral election.

item.title: Here’s a list of what Olivia Chow has promised to do in her second term
item.description: Olivia Chow has managed to hang on to the top job on council, fending off a challenge from Brad Bradford to keep her job. Here’s everything Chow has said she would do in her second term.

item.title: Take a closer look at some of the more closely contested Toronto city council races
item.description: Outside of the Toronto mayoral race, there were several contests for city council seats that made headlines in the leadup to Monday’s election, including four wards where an incumbent was not running.

item.title: Did Scarborough pave the way to re-election for Olivia Chow? Take a closer look at her path to victory
item.description: Olivia Chow has won a second term as mayor of Toronto, beating out challenger Brad Bradford in a hard-fought election.

item.title: Toronto tenants are facing a wave of rental building demolitions. What advocates say councillors can do
item.description: New data shared with CTV News Toronto is revealing the number of rental buildings and units approved for demolition across the city as tenants grapple with being uprooted during an affordability crisis.

item.title: ‘We’re saving lives’: Chris Alexander unveils plan to move Toronto’s unhoused into apartments
item.description: Toronto mayoral candidate Chris Alexander is promising to move thousands of people experiencing homelessness out of shelters and into permanent housing, aiming for 1,000 placements by summer 2027 as part of a four-year plan to relieve pressure on the city’s over-burdened shelter system.

item.title: Toronto mayoral candidate promises to waive municipal land transfer tax on first $1.1M of purchase price
item.description: Brad Bradford has announced that he will waive the municipal land transfer tax on the first $1.1 million of the value of homes purchased in Toronto if elected mayor but Olivia Chow is warning that doing so would inevitably result in service cuts.

item.title: Chow holds Scarborough rally, Bradford questions her $788M savings claim
item.description: With one month until election day, building Scarborough and questions about budget savings dominated the Toronto mayoral campaign trail on Saturday.

item.title: Olivia Chow vows to create ‘bad landlords task force’ if re-elected. Here is how it would work
item.description: Toronto mayoral candidate Olivia Chow is promising to create a dedicated “bad landlords task force” within RentSafeTO if re-elected, saying the city needs to be more “proactive” in going after landlords who fail to maintain their properties.

item.title: Bradford promises tax freeze as Chow defends inflation-based increases. Here’s what you need to know
item.description: Toronto mayoral candidate Brad Bradford is promising to freeze property taxes for a year if he becomes mayor, while Olivia Chow worries the move could bring cuts and send the city 'back to the bad old days.'

item.title: ‘The system isn’t working:’ Mayoral candidate wants to hike TTC fares to bring in millions in new revenue
item.description: Mayoral candidate Chris Alexander is promising to hike TTC fares and crack down on fare enforcement in an effort to generate an estimated $100 million in new revenue that he says could be put towards “fixing” the system.

item.title: ‘Read between the lines’: Doug Ford offers support for Olivia Chow but stops short of endorsement
item.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford may have stopped short of pinning an “Olivia Chow for Mayor” button on his suit lapel, but he made clear Wednesday he is backing her in the midst of her bid for re-election.

item.title: Weekly TTC fare cap of 10 paid rides proposed by Olivia Chow. Here is how it would work
item.description: Mayoral candidate Olivia Chow is promising to make the TTC free after 10 paid rides in a week, arguing that 'families shouldn’t have to choose between rent, food and getting around.'

item.title: Brad Bradford vows to make Scarborough East Rapid Transit Line ‘top priority’ if elected
item.description: Toronto mayoral candidate Brad Bradford is promising to have shovels in the ground on the largely unfunded Scarborough East LRT by 2030.
